notes.title: CELESTIAL RETURN: BIG UPDATE IS LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

We’ve been quiet… but for good reason. We just dropped a major update for Celestial Return, and it’s packed with changes you’ve gotta see. 

WHAT’S NEW?

🔹Updated Dice Mechanics – We’ve made some huge changes to the dice system, to make it way more strategic. Dice aren’t just luck anymore, they’re currency.
🔹 Fresh UI – We stripped the clutter. Everything’s smoother, sharper, and way less “what-do-I-click-again?

Thanks for hanging in there while we made these upgrades!

As always, let us know what you think, we’re all ears. 

Cheers,

P.S. More tweaks are coming (we’re never done). Jump in our [Discord] to rant, rave, or roast us. We’ll listen.
